_help: Describes this model. stl is relative to this folder. mountOffsetMm / mountRotationDeg say where the STL's origin sits in the PLATE frame (origin = centre of the plate top, X right, Y far edge, Z up), so they are zero when the model is centred on the plate and its STL origin is the centre of its base.
name: F1
notes: 'F1 Car' by Digi-Kitsamus (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:364951), licensed CC BY-SA; this simplified copy is shared under the same licence. The original (131,688 triangles: a body and four print-in-place wheels, plus an internal cavity) was reduced to 6000 triangles with python -m aero.decimate, which dropped the cavity and kept every shell closed. Car along X, nose toward -X; the mount offset centres it on the plate with the wheels on it.
